item.title: £2m TA BI U-TURN
item.description: CELTIC’S proposed £2million deal for Ivory Coast winger Jocelin Ta Bi is OFF. The anticipated move for the 20-year-old forward has been scuppered due to fitness issues. The transfer stalled following medical tests reportedly revealed an issue that would require surgery, according to The Herald. item.title: EX-CELT’S QUICKFIRE RETURN
item.description: FORMER Celtic midfielder Barry Robson has made a quickfire return to the dug-out after being sacked by Raith Rovers in November. The 47-year-old gaffer, dismissed by Aberdeen in January 2024, has agreed to a two-year deal to become new manager of Cork City. item.title: ‘EXQUISITE,’ MARTIN’S PRAISE FOR NYGREN
item.description: BENJAMIN NYGREN’S cool finish for Celtic’s third goal in the 4-0 win over Dundee United at Parkhead on Saturday was the Swede’s eleventh strike in his debut campaign at the champions.
